WHAT WAS ASKED — ROLE-SPECIFIC ACCOUNTS
An SDE-2 record reports three hour-long stages: DSA/LLD, coding, and system/machine design. The listed areas include stacks, priority queues, hashes, matrices, tries, sorting, object-oriented design and clean implementation.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc1Mw

A senior frontend account covers CLS/FCP/LCP, lazy loading, code splitting, render-blocking resources and the DNS-to-rendering request lifecycle. A coding task involved union and intersection of sorted arrays. These are senior frontend interview topics, not a documented campus OA format.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc1Mg

An SDE-3 account reports a HireHunch coding/project discussion followed by object modeling and low-level design. The separate merchandising experience in the source inventory is a different job family and should not guide software-engineering preparation.
Source: https://www.oahelper.in/interview-experience/MTc1MQ
